bootstrap.method: percentile bootstrap over queries, one index matrix shared by all configs (paired deltas)

fallbacks: listwise rerank by token overlap (no LLM)
query expansion by keyword heuristic (no LLM)
PPR over regex triples with a hand-written path prior (no LLM extraction)
chunk prefix from path words (no LLM)

late_chunking.pooling: mean of document-level token embeddings per chunk span; queries and one-chunk files keep the model's own pooling

fallbacks: HyDE hypothesis by keyword heuristic (no LLM)
HyDE hypothesis by keyword heuristic (no LLM)
regex triples, connected components, extractive summaries (no LLM, no Leiden)

frontier.verdict_rule: paired bootstrap interval of nDCG@10 (arm minus parent): above zero, covers zero, or below zero
